query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_molecules,
  SUM(CASE WHEN casNumber IS NULL OR casNumber = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_cas,
  SUM(CASE WHEN iupacName IS NULL OR iupacName = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_iupac,
  SUM(CASE WHEN chemicalClass IS NULL OR chemicalClass = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_class,
  SUM(CASE WHEN formula IS NULL OR formula = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_formula
FROM molecules;
